notes: §1985:XIII.4.4.4 GR3: 'A subsequent INITIATE statement for report-name-1 must not be executed unless an intervening TERMINATE statement has been executed', a prohibition on the program with no stated result. ReportWriter.Initiate (one call per name, EmitInitiate) re-arms a report TerminateCore left inactive, and for an active report raises EC-REPORT-ACTIVE, which cannot be enabled at 85 (>>TURN is COBOL0900 there), then returns with no other effect. Probes at 85: INITIATE after TERMINATE resets LINE-COUNTER 0, PAGE-COUNTER 1 and an 18-digit negative SUM; a second INITIATE while active and INITIATE RPT RPT leave LC, PC and the sum unchanged with no abend; INITIATE after a failed OPEN EXTEND (35) takes no action; the witness re-initiates and prints REINITIATED.

next.reason: Both forbid INITIATE of a report already initiated and not terminated; 1985 states no result for a violation. 2023 §2023:14.9.21.4 GR2: 'An INITIATE statement shall not be executed if report-name-1 is in the active state. If it is in the active state, the EC-REPORT-ACTIVE exception condition is set to exist and the execution of the INITIATE statement has no other effect'; §2023:14.9.21.4 GR4 makes INITIATE set the active state, and the report section prose §2023:13.8.4 (no catalog rule) ends it at TERMINATE. Undefined run-time result became a defined exception condition.
